title: Valid login with correct credentials
preconditions: Browser is open, https://www.saucedemo.com is reachable, standard_user account exists
expected: User is redirected to the products page at /inventory.html and the product list is visible

title: Login rejected with invalid username
preconditions: Browser is open, https://www.saucedemo.com is reachable
expected: An error message is displayed: 'Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service'. User remains on the login page.

title: Login rejected with invalid password
preconditions: Browser is open, https://www.saucedemo.com is reachable
expected: An error message is displayed: 'Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service'. User remains on the login page.

title: Locked-out user cannot log in
preconditions: Browser is open, https://www.saucedemo.com is reachable
expected: An error message is displayed: 'Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out.' User remains on the login page.

title: Login rejected when both fields are empty
preconditions: Browser is open, https://www.saucedemo.com is reachable
expected: An error message is displayed: 'Epic sadface: Username is required'. User remains on the login page.

title: Login rejected when only username is provided
preconditions: Browser is open, https://www.saucedemo.com is reachable
expected: An error message is displayed: 'Epic sadface: Password is required'. User remains on the login page.

title: Login page loads correctly on navigation
preconditions: Browser is open with network access
steps: Verify the page title is 'Swag Labs'
Verify the Username input field is visible
Verify the Password input field is visible
Verify the Login button is visible and enabled
expected: Login page renders with all expected elements present and the URL is https://www.saucedemo.com/

title: Error message clarity and wording for invalid credentials
preconditions: Browser is open, https://www.saucedemo.com is reachable
steps: Enter any invalid username and password combination
Assess whether the wording is clear and helpful to a real user
Check that the error icon (X) is visible next to the message
expected: Error message is clearly worded, not misleading, and provides enough context for the user to understand what went wrong without revealing security-sensitive information

title: Login form visual layout and alignment
preconditions: Browser is open at a 1280x800 desktop viewport
steps: Inspect the overall page layout — logo, form container, field labels
Verify the Username and Password fields are visually aligned
Verify the Login button spans the expected width
Check that there is adequate spacing between elements
Check that no elements overlap or are cut off
expected: Login form is visually balanced, fields and button are properly aligned, no UI clutter or broken layout

title: Exploratory UX pass on login flow
preconditions: Browser is open, https://www.saucedemo.com is reachable
steps: Tab through all form fields using the keyboard
Enter credentials using keyboard only (no mouse)
Press Enter to submit the form
Attempt to navigate back after a successful login
Note any unexpected or confusing behaviour
expected: All interactions feel intuitive; keyboard navigation works without issues; pressing Enter submits the form; back navigation behaves predictably

title: Input field placeholder text is present and correct
preconditions: Browser is open, https://www.saucedemo.com is reachable
steps: Observe the placeholder text in the Username field before typing
Observe the placeholder text in the Password field before typing
Verify placeholder text disappears when the field is focused and typed into
expected: Username field shows placeholder 'Username', Password field shows placeholder 'Password'; both disappear upon user input

title: Login button and field tap target size (accessibility check)
preconditions: Browser is open, https://www.saucedemo.com is reachable
steps: Use browser DevTools to inspect the computed height of the Username field
Inspect the computed height of the Password field
Inspect the computed height of the Login button
Verify all interactive elements meet a minimum 44px height
expected: All interactive form elements are at least 44px tall, meeting WCAG 2.5.5 target size guidance

title: Problem user can log in (degraded experience acknowledged)
preconditions: Browser is open, https://www.saucedemo.com is reachable
steps: Manually verify that the products page loads (images may be broken — this is expected behaviour for problem_user)
expected: User is redirected to /inventory.html. Automated check confirms redirection; manual check notes any visual anomalies on the product page as known issues.

title: Page branding and logo display
preconditions: Browser is open, https://www.saucedemo.com is reachable
steps: Verify the Swag Labs logo is visible at the top of the login page
Verify the logo is not broken (no missing image icon)
Verify the page favicon is present in the browser tab
expected: Logo renders correctly, page favicon is visible, branding is consistent with the Sauce Labs demo app identity
